name: komdosh-dev-infra-terraform
description: Terraform and OpenTofu authoring, plan-safety analysis, and state discipline. Ships the terraform-author agent (module structure, pinned providers, for_each over count, remote encrypted state, tagging) and the read-only terraform-reviewer agent (correctness · state safety · security · cost · drift), two internal skills (discover-terraform-layout repo-mapper, verify-plan-safety plan classifier that flags forces-replacement on stateful resources before apply), three rule documents (terraform-style, terraform-state-safety, terraform-plan-review), and three commands: /tf-module, /tf-plan-review, /tf-audit. Uses the Terraform registry MCP for current provider/module versions when available. Never runs apply or destroy. Requires komdosh-dev-infra-core.
